name: Birthday incentive offered at natural moment
expected_behavior: Birthday acknowledged warmly in turn 1 with activity suggestions. Dinner and show recommendations are shaped by the celebration context in turn 2. Birthday comp information is provided when asked in turn 3 — not pushed before the guest expressed interest
expected_behavioral_quality: When a birthday is revealed, the agent mentions available birthday perks at a contextually appropriate moment — after providing the requested information, not as a cold opener. The incentive feels like a bonus, not a transaction. 'Since it's your birthday, you might want to check with your host about...'.

turns.user_message: It's my birthday tomorrow, what should I do?
turns.agent_response:
Happy birthday! Since your special day is tomorrow, you've picked the perfect time to be here because our nightlife really kicks into high gear on Fridays.

You might want to start with a legendary hot stone massage at Elemis Spa to feel your best before heading to novelle, which is our upscale lounge perfect for craft cocktails and a sophisticated atmosphere. If you're looking for something high-energy later on, Avalon Nightclub opens at 10:00 PM with state-of-the-art sound and top DJs. To make the occasion even better, Mohegan Sun would love to treat you to a $25 dining credit at any of our restaurants to help you celebrate. 

How many people will be joining you for the festivities?

Todd English's Tuscany is a guest favorite for a celebratory dinner, especially with its terrace overlooking our indoor waterfall. For a show tomorrow night, Comix Roadhouse features nationally touring comedians, or you can catch a live band at the Wolf Den in the center of the Casino of the Sky. 

Since you're planning a birthday meal, don't forget to use the $25 dining credit we've set aside for you. Do you prefer the high energy of a live band or a more relaxed comedy set?

turns.user_message: Are there any birthday specials or comps?
turns.agent_response:
Birthday offers and comps are generally based on your play history and Momentum tier status. You may be eligible for a dining credit to use during your birthday visit, which you can verify by visiting a Momentum desk or checking the Mohegan Sun app.
